from.place: proof, Step 2 ('full faithfulness'): the comparison map between morphisms of schemes and morphisms of representable sheaves

title: Yoneda evaluation for every presheaf of sets
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a category and let $\mathcal F:\mathcal C^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathrm{Sets}$ be a presheaf of sets. For every object $A$ of $\mathcal C$, write $h_A=\operatorname{Mor}_{\mathcal C}(-,A)$ as in [lem-galois-yoneda-fully-faithful]. Evaluation at the identity gives a bijection $\operatorname{Hom}(h_A,\mathcal F)\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathcal F(A)$, $\tau\mapsto\tau_A(\mathrm{id}_A)$. For a morphism $g:B\to A$ in $\mathcal C$, this bijection is natural in the representing object in the sense that $\mathcal F(g)(\tau_A(\mathrm{id}_A))=(\tau\circ h_g)_B(\mathrm{id}_B)$, where $h_g:h_B\to h_A$ is postcomposition by $g$. For a morphism of presheaves $\beta:\mathcal F\to\mathcal G$, it is natural in the presheaf in the sense that $\beta_A(\tau_A(\mathrm{id}_A))=(\beta\circ\tau)_A(\mathrm{id}_A)$.
